Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 4, 2026

Zephyr Archive, LLC (“Zephyr Archive,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit zephyrarchive.com (the “Site”) or buy from us, how we use and share it, and the choices you have.

Information we collect

Information you give us. When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, shipping and billing address, and phone number. Payment details are entered on Shopify’s secure checkout and handled by our payment processors; we never see or store your full card number. If you sign up for updates, we collect your email address. If you contact us, we keep what you send us.

Information collected automatically. When you use the Site, we and our service providers may collect information about your device and visit, such as your browser type, IP address, pages viewed, the site that referred you, and the time of your visit. Some of this is collected through cookies and similar technologies (see below).

How we use your information

  • To process and ship your orders, take payment, and send order and shipping updates.
  • To answer your questions and provide customer support.
  • To send you news about releases and offers, if you have asked to hear from us.
  • To keep the Site and our store secure and to prevent fraud.
  • To understand how the Site is used and improve it.
  • To meet our legal, tax, and accounting obligations.

How we share your information

We share personal information only as needed to run our store, including with:

  • Shopify, which powers our product catalog, cart, checkout, and order management.
  • Payment processors, which handle payments on our behalf.
  • Shipping carriers, so your order reaches you.
  • Website hosting and email providers that help us run the Site and send messages.

We may also disclose information if required by law, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or as part of a sale or transfer of our business. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies and similar technologies

The Site and Shopify’s checkout use cookies and your browser’s local storage to remember what is in your cart, keep checkout working, and understand how the Site is used. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, but parts of the Site, such as the cart and checkout, may not work properly without them.

Emails from us

If you sign up for updates, you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any of our emails or by contacting us. We will still send messages about orders you place.

How long we keep information

We keep personal information for as long as we need it to fulfill orders, provide support, and meet legal, tax, and accounting requirements, and then delete or anonymize it.

Your rights and choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask what personal information we hold about you, to correct or delete it, to receive a copy of it, or to opt out of certain uses. To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding, and we will not treat you differently for exercising your rights.

Security

We use reasonable safeguards, and rely on providers with industry-standard security, to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Children’s privacy

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

Where information is processed

We are based in the United States, and your information may be stored and processed in the United States or other countries where our service providers operate.

Links to other sites

The Site may link to other websites. Their privacy practices are their own, and we encourage you to read their policies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the “Last updated” date above. Significant changes will be posted on this page.

Contact us

Questions or requests about your privacy can be sent to:

Zephyr Archive, LLC
Email: support@zephyrarchive.com
